summary: Tested the hourly FB auto-import: cron auth, background ack, enable/disable, dedup (repeated, concurrent, soft-deleted), author selection, and the admin dialog UI. All 12 backend tests passed and every UI check passed. No duplicates were created; the FB article count stayed at 5 the whole time.

minor.issue: When no author_id is set, manual import uses the logged-in user as author (import_author(user) fallback). The UI option says 'Vlasnik portala (prvi Super Admin)', and only the cron path uses the first super_admin. The label does not match the behaviour.

published_by, created_by, media uploaded_by and the version/audit actor are all set to the chosen author, not the operator who clicked import. The audit trail cannot show who actually ran a manual import.

ui_bugs.issue: The fb-import-remove-samples checkbox is checked by default (useState(true)). One accidental click on 'Uvezi i objavi' soft-deletes all 8 'primjer' articles. Consider defaulting it to false.

issues: If the selected author is later deactivated, the backend silently falls back to another author while the select may show an empty or mismatched value. Consider showing a warning.

action_items: Optional: make the manual-import fallback author match the UI label (first super_admin), or rename the option to 'Trenutni korisnik / Vlasnik'
Optional: default remove_samples checkbox to unchecked
Optional: keep the operator id in the audit entry for manual imports
critical_code_review_comments: IMPORT_LOCK is per-process. It works with --workers 1, and the unique partial indexes on fb_post_key and fb_post_hash protect against duplicates across workers or containers, which the concurrent test confirmed.
The dedup query deliberately ignores the deleted flag, so soft-deleted posts are never re-imported (confirmed by test).
auto_job swallows exceptions and only logs a warning. last_run is not updated when FB returns 502, so the UI can't show that a run failed. Consider storing last_error.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_journalist user and hard-deleted it afterwards. Temporarily hard-deleted one FB article; it was re-imported with the chosen author, then its author was restored to the original. Temporarily soft-deleted another FB article and restored it. fb_auto was restored to enabled:true, author_id:null. Sample 'primjer' articles were not touched (8 active).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_fb_auto_import.py -n 0 (the tests are order-dependent). Super admin test_fb@ccn.ba / TestFb12345A. The FB plugin exposes 5 posts and all 5 are imported. Leftover soft-deleted TEST_ users from iteration 7 remain in the DB.
